correctness.rationale: For k>=3, n>=4, 2<=a<=n-2, the all-zero state or an all-vertex rotating state are the only states fixed by the kth iterate. Directed successor edges force a k-divisible directed simple cycle, and the chorded graph has exactly three simple cycles. Along the complementary path the internal successor condition yields a unique normal form of the k-ary increment word and exact endpoint-difference count H. Pairwise cycle-family overlaps comprise 2k states; three-way overlap is impossible, giving the claimed Q formula with positive iff condition. An independently coded endpoint-flag transfer passed 10,266 cases; direct full-map exhaustive enumeration passed 1,301,418 inputs on 30 cases. Arithmetic k=4 specialization checked algebraically. Residual proof risk is a potential unrecognized alias of the structural counting reduction, not an unverified computational extrapolation.

value.rationale: A single chord is a natural local perturbation of a finite excitable ring. Exact k-wave orbital populations across all palette sizes and all chord positions are a substantive infinite-family invariant; the support existence criterion depends on three competing modular cycle lengths, and pairwise intersections require nontrivial counting. The k4 span-three corollary causes waves on every ring length where the unchorded ring may have none, with a four-residue linear amplification law. No claim of global period classification or basin measurements is made.
